h2: Plumber & Pool Service in Canggu – What Villa Owners Need to Know
intro: Canggu went from open rice paddies to a dense patchwork of villas, cafés and co-living spaces almost overnight, and the plumbing and pools underneath rarely received the same care as the finishes above. If you're searching for a plumber and pool service in Canggu that actually understands why septic tanks fill faster here or why garden drains reverse after every downpour, Bali Fix is built around exactly those local quirks.

sections.h3: What Breaks First in a Fast-Built Canggu Villa
sections.text: Many properties were erected quickly on former paddy land, so hidden leaks behind tile work, loose copper fittings and poorly sloped floor drains tend to announce themselves within the first couple of seasons. The high water table inherited from old rice fields means septic systems fill sooner than owners expect, and garden drains can reverse-flow during heavy rain. A quick inspection of pump rooms, overflow lines and tank levels before the wet season saves a lot of emergency calls later.

sections.h3: The Calls We Get Most Often Around Berawa and Batu Bolong
sections.text: Blocked toilets and kitchen sinks top the list, followed by water-heater faults and pump failures that leave a villa without hot water for a day or two. Pool cleaning and weekly maintenance round out the schedule because leaves drift in from surrounding greenery and daily guest turnover keeps chlorine levels shifting. Properties near Echo Beach or Pererenan see slightly more leaf load and salt-air corrosion on outdoor fittings, so we factor that into our routine visits.

sections.h3: Where Bali Fix Works Across All Six Neighbourhoods
sections.text: Our team covers every pocket – Berawa, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Pererenan, Babakan and Padonan – whether it's a single-bedroom rental off Jalan Pantai Berawa or a larger compound closer to the Babakan intersection. You send photos over WhatsApp, we assess the job, and a technician heads straight to your gate with the right parts. No call centre, no waiting for a callback; the person who scopes your issue is the one who shows up.

sections.h3: Rainy-Season Checklist Before the First Big Downpour
sections.text: Between October and March the streets around Canggu turn into rivers, and garden pumps that handled dry season fine suddenly struggle. We recommend checking pool overflow drains, clearing pump-room intakes, confirming septic tank levels and testing backup sump pumps while there's still time. A short WhatsApp message with a photo of your pump room or drain outlet is usually enough for us to flag what needs attention before water starts pooling under your villa.

faq.q: Do you cover villas in Babakan and Padonan as well?
faq.a: Yes – our technicians work across all six neighbourhoods from Berawa through to Padonan. Send a quick photo on WhatsApp and we'll confirm availability for your specific address.

faq.q: How do I get a quote without calling anyone?
faq.a: Snap a few photos of the issue – a leaking fitting, a blocked drain, a cloudy pool – and send them over WhatsApp. We'll reply with what we think it is and how the job would be scoped; final pricing depends on access and any parts needed on site.

faq.q: My septic tank keeps backing up after rain. Is that normal here?
faq.a: It's more common than owners expect because Canggu sits on former paddy land with a high groundwater table, so tanks fill faster than in drier areas. A regular inspection and desludging schedule can keep it from becoming an emergency during the wet months.
